pages.title: Giant Camel
pages.text: The giant camel ($(o)Camelus knoblochi$()) is an extinct camel that lived across the steppes of Central Asia, Siberia, Mongolia and northern China during the Pleistocene, until about 27,000 years ago.$(br2)It was the largest member of the modern camel genus, roughly twice the weight of living wild camels.$(br2)Its last populations shared their range with early humans, and its extinction coincided with the drying of the Asian steppe.
